name: h3-control-hybrid-v1
status: default H3 render recipe; a task-agnostic starting point, not a task qualification
description: MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA + H3-Fun ControlNet-Union (soft-HED) + white inpaint hybrid, rendered by src/datafarm/render/h3/h3_control_worker.py. Control rows cover generated target rows only; reference rows get zero control rows. Copy to <run>/recipes/<name>.json, set name/bundle_variant, keep every algorithmic field unless a task canary shows a reason, and qualify it per task (full-episode canary + independent blind review).

screen.kind: producer-side VLM per-chunk seed screen (not acceptance)
screen.ood_preference: one seed for all chunks when it is clean in every chunk (consistent OOD look)

exposure_lock.model: per panel/channel exposure gain through the origin (median output/white brightness); gains only, no pixel moved or retimed

references_policy.real_scene: one state-matched real full-view T-layout frame per episode: the task state (e.g. device display on/off, container open/closed, object placement) must match the white carrier at the render start; prefer an object-free real plate derived from the episode (h3_clean_references.py) when objects move
references_policy.robot: a real robot sheet that keeps the real arm appearance (dark links, shoulder motor, gripper, wrist camera) and no cables; without real dark links the model copies the white sim arm from the white video reference
references_policy.objects: no isolated object sheets: they make the generator re-insert the object on the table (the scene frame and the carrier carry object appearance and position)
references_policy.order: contract real references first (images-first); the white carrier clip is appended as a 39-frame video reference by the worker
references_policy.derivation: references are task artifacts the agent derives from the current real episode; see src/datafarm/render/h3/BUNDLE-SCHEMA.md

per_task_knobs.prompt_lowering: h3-caption-chunkvis-notask (default) | h3-caption-chunkvis-noevents; keep notask when whole-task text draws future states
per_task_knobs.chunk.event_aware: {"before": 24, "min_advance": 48} moves a chunk start ahead of an arm entering/leaving the head view

evaluation.acceptance: independent blind review per evaluations/render-h3/reviewer-instructions-v1.md (EVAL-v1); the producer and the seed screen never certify

requirements.mode: explicit current-user mode (and OOD axes) recorded in the task bundle mode_confirmations; never inferred from this recipe
requirements.gpu: one GPU with >= 172 GB free per worker
requirements.licence: MiniMax-H3 LICENSE V.3 restricts using outputs to improve other models and excludes territories; see docs/reference/rendering.md
